8.7.3.10 KeyM_ServiceCertificateCallbackNotification
[SWS_KeyM_00147] Definition of configurable interface <KeyM_ServiceCertifi-
cateCallbackNotification>
Upstream requirements: SRS_CryptoStack_00100, SRS_BSW_00310, SRS_BSW_00312
⌈
Service Name
<KeyM_ServiceCertificateCallbackNotification>
Syntax
void <KeyM_ServiceCertificateCallbackNotification> (
KeyM_CertificateIdType CertId,
KeyM_ResultType Result
)
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
CertId
The certificate identifier where this service was started for.
Parameters (in)
Result
Contains information about the result of the operation.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Notifies the application that the certificate service operation has been finished. This function is
used by the certificate submodule. This callback is only provided if KeyMServiceCertificate
FunctionEnabled is set to TRUE. The function name is configurable by KeyMServiceCertificate
CallbackNotificationFunc.
Available via
KeyM_Externals.h
⌋
[SWS_KeyM_00152]
Upstream requirements: SRS_CryptoStack_00106
⌈If KeyMServiceCertificateFunctionEnabled is set to TRUE and KeyM_ServiceCertifi-
cate{ByCertId}() was called successfully by returning E_OK and KeyMServiceCertifi-
cateCallbackNotificationFunc is configured with a valid function name, this function will
get called for the corresponding certificate to indicate the result of the requested oper-
ation.⌋
